svg.title: dsh-evidence-check structure: one evidence list, seven rules mounted on the fields they read
svg.desc: A register (header plus rows and columns) is read with alias matching and a requireAnyOf guard; the seven rules hang under the exact columns they read, with EV-006 on the header band and EV-005 the only across-row rule; results leave as issues located by row and field plus skipped entries carrying a reason; a staircase shows the severity cap each basis kind imposes.
svg.text: evidence_check · rules/evidence-check.yaml · 7 rules · validated on load
parseMaterial · one list, header + rows × columns
declared once for the whole list
RULES · runCheck · each rule hangs on the field it reads
column names match ignoring case, spaces, _ and - ; requireAnyOf guard on the row columns
at least one of them filled
fill the name and the fact it proves
skipped[] · a check that cannot run names why
values unset: the form vocabulary is
skipped is not a pass — a check that cannot run names its reason
no verdict — found / expected / fix, never “compliant”
source read-only · no network · no model call
Apache-2.0 · pure ESM · no native code · native and ptc tool modes · issues sorted by severity, rule id, locator
